- Option D directly aligns with the story's description: Dekai is afraid of the dog when passing Mr. Wang's house, which is why she refuses to go despite wanting to swing.

OPTION-A: Because she doesn't like the amusement park, so she says she doesn't want to go to the amusement park.
OPTION-B: Because she thinks it's too far and too troublesome to go to the amusement park.
OPTION-C: Because she thinks the amusement park is too far away and doesn't want to go.
OPTION-D: Because she is afraid of walking past the dogs, so she doesn't want to go to the amusement park.
